messages.text: Team, Redis memory costs are creeping up. I strongly suggest we migrate everything over to Memcached by end of month.
Hold on, our background task daemon in PR #89 relies on Redis distributed locks (Redlock). Does Memcached support that natively?
Good point. Let me open an exploratory spike PR #68 to benchmark it first.
Update: Memcached failed our cluster failover criteria. We are keeping Redis Cluster and dropping Memcached.
ALERT: Staging background sync daemon crashing with exit code 1: MissingEnvironmentError: X_INTERNAL_SYNC_SALT not found.
I checked docs/runbooks/staging_deploy.md but X_INTERNAL_SYNC_SALT is not documented anywhere! Who has this salt value?
My bad! I temporarily set X_INTERNAL_SYNC_SALT in the staging Kubernetes ConfigMap directly. We need to document this in the offboarding guide.
CONFIDENTIAL: Q4 infra budget is capped at $45,000/mo. Alex's replacement salary bracket is approved between $140k-$165k.
